summary: Iter81 Phase 2 — Strict Equipment Matching. Backend: 25/25 unit tests pass in test_iter81_phase2_equipment_gate.py + 4/4 NEW integration tests pass in test_iter81_phase2_resolver_integration.py verifying apply_resolver_to_workouts sets equipment_check/equipment_reason/needs_coach_review/change_reason correctly, and that stats dict now includes equipment_failures + workouts_needs_review counters. Home context uses 'Your setup is missing kit' prefix; layover-with-unknown-hotel uses 'Hotel gym is limited' prefix + optional hotel name. Frontend: PATCHed two client workouts via MongoDB to inject change_reason + needs_coach_review + failing exercises. Verified via mobile-viewport playwright (390x844): (a) home pill testID workout-reason-<id> renders correctly with reason line (verified on the 2026-07-23 workout appearing on client home), (b) workout-detail banner testID workout-change-reason renders WHY THIS CHANGED header + full reason and is positioned above WHY THIS SESSION? rationale (Y coords 637 vs 755), (c) amber warning boxes testID ex-eq-warn-0 and ex-eq-warn-1 render on failing exercises with equipment_reason text (Requires a barbell — not available at your current setup / Requires a cable machine — not available at your current setup), (d) passing exercise (Push-Up idx 2) correctly renders NO warning, (e) workouts without change_reason show no phantom pill (calendar page had zero pills). Test data cleaned up (change_reason + needs_coach_review unset). No regressions.

minor.issue: WorkoutUpdateBody Pydantic model does NOT expose change_reason or needs_coach_review — they are silently dropped by `{k: v for k, v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}`. This is fine for production (only resolver writes these fields) but blocks the manual test hook described in the review-request AGENT-TO-AGENT note (option b). Worked around by writing directly to MongoDB. Consider adding both optional fields to WorkoutUpdateBody if coach-side manual override is ever needed.

action_items: Optional: expose change_reason + needs_coach_review on WorkoutUpdateBody so PATCH /api/workouts/{wid} supports manual coach override (currently silently filtered).
critical_code_review_comments: feature_equipment_matcher.py: clean pure module (~350 lines), well-commented, no side effects. Regex ordering is correct (specific → general), first-match wins. FULL_GYM_EXPANSION correctly covers common hotel-gym lifts.

feature_v2_resolver.apply_resolver_to_workouts: equipment gate runs AFTER library resolution. Note: exercises that don't match the tiny approved-pool are DROPPED before the gate, so the gate only enforces on library-matched exercises. This is by design per current pool policy — as the approved pool grows, more exercises will be gated.
hotel_context resolution: classify_stay + resolve_gym_equipment correctly plug in per-workout; unknown hotel → bodyweight-only; known hotel → hotel's normalised equipment map.

Frontend home.tsx reasonPill (line 566-569) + workout/[id]/index.tsx changeReason banner (267-275) + eqWarn (327-332) all guard on truthy change_reason / equipment_check==='fail' so no phantom UI when field missing.
Banner correctly positioned before rationale block (line 267 before 277).
All 4 new testIDs (workout-reason-<id>, workout-change-reason, ex-eq-warn-<idx>) are stable and confirmed via playwright.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 testIDs render correctly, banner positioning correct, no phantom UI on clean workouts)

Both change_reason/needs_coach_review fields were unset after verification. NOTE: the exercises array on wid 72b44335... was overwritten via API PATCH during testing (now has Barbell Bench Press / Cable Row / Push-Up with equipment_check fields) — harmless since that workout is dated 2020-06-29 and marked completed:true, invisible on current home.
